parameters.text:
=As an expert hiring manager, analyze the Job Description and Candidate Resume.

### JOB DESCRIPTION
{{ $json.job_description }}

### CANDIDATE RESUME
{{ $('Extract from File').item.json.text }}

### INSTRUCTIONS
Return a single JSON object with two keys: "skills" and "score".
- "skills": An array of the top skills from the job description.
- "score": A number from 1 to 5 indicating how well the resume matches the job skills.

Example Output:
{
  "skills": ["Project Management", "Agile Methodologies", "JIRA"],
  "score": 4
}

nodes.name: Score Resume Match to Extracted Skills from Job Description

parameters.text:
=You are an expert career writer. Based on the Job Description and the Candidate's Resume, perform the following two tasks.

### ROLE DETAILS
- Job Title: {{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.job_title }}
- Company: {{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.company_name }}

### CANDIDATE RESUME
{{ $('Extract from File').item.json.text }}

### INSTRUCTIONS
First, rewrite the resume as a clean HTML fragment optimized for this job.
Second, write a persuasive, ATS-friendly cover letter as an HTML fragment for this job.

Structure your entire response with the following clear headings so I can parse it easily. Do not include any other text or explanation.

### REWRITTEN RESUME ###
[The full rewritten resume HTML goes here]

### COVER LETTER ###
[The full cover letter HTML goes here]

=Hi {{ $('Webhook').item.json.body.name }},

There was an issue while processing your job application. Please resubmit your resume or try again later.

Sorry for the inconvenience!

The JobMonkey Team

nodes.name: Send a message if process failed

parameters.subject: =  An Issue with Your JobMonkey Request
parameters.html:
=

Hi {{ $json.userName }},

We're writing to let you know that there was an issue processing your recent JobMonkey request.

Reason: {{ $json.reason }}

This can sometimes happen if no jobs matching your criteria were found, or if the jobs found were not a strong match for your resume after being scored by the AI.

Not to worry, a refund for this request has been processed automatically.

You are welcome to try again with a different job title or an updated resume. If you continue to experience issues, please don't hesitate to contact support by replying this email or gerald@dominixai.com.

Thanks,
The JobMonkey Team
